function: Acyltransferase that catalyzes the sn-2-specific, acyl-CoA-dependent acylation of lysophosphatidic acid (LPA) to phosphatidic acid (PA) in lipid particles (PubMed:9401016). Together with ALE1, plays a central role in PA biosynthesis. PA is the intermediate, from which all glycerophospholipids are synthesized (PubMed:17890783). Can also acylate lysophosphoinositol (LPI) and lysophosphoserine (LPS) (PubMed:17675291). The fatty acyl substrates include 18:1-acyl-CoA, 14:0-acyl-CoA, 12:0-acyl-CoA and 10:0-acyl-CoA (PubMed:20694142).
